description: This file defines the Telegram approval native capability, including functions for resolving targets, handling approval requests, and configuring approval behaviors within a larger approval system.

methods.name: resolveTurnSourceTelegramOriginTarget
methods.description: Resolves the origin target for a turn source in Telegram, returning the chat ID and optional thread ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionTelegramOriginTarget
methods.description: Resolves the session origin target for Telegram, normalizing the chat ID.

methods.name: telegramTargetsMatch
methods.description: Checks if two Telegram origin targets match based on chat ID and thread ID.

methods.name: resolveTelegramApproveCommandBehavior
methods.description: Determines the behavior for Telegram approval commands, primarily returning a reply with an error message if approvals are not enabled.
